t: The Signature Vision: Utility Fog Systems
title: The Signature Vision: Utility Fog Systems
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Utility Fog Systems.

Signature fog hulls program, charter one: master foglets at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale fog logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate lattice control systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Utility Fog Systems becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2031 — First fog hulls product ships at scale: foglets synthesis proven
title: 2031 — First fog hulls product ships at scale: foglets synthesis proven
definition: 2031 milestone on the Utility Fog Systems roadmap.
description:
First fog hulls product ships at scale: foglets synthesis proven outside the lab.

What must be true first: the foglets results have to replicate outside the lab, fog logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and lattice control operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed foglets demonstrations, fog logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting lattice control uptime. When all three flash green, 2031 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (5 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Utility Fog Systems
definition: Estimates Utility Fog Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Utility Fog Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a fog hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Utility Fog Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Utility Fog Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Utility Fog Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 7645 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where foglets monitoring, fog logistics redundancy, or lattice control maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Utility Fog Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Utility Fog Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Utility Fog Systems — fog of nanobots forming any structure.

Phase 1 — Prove (foglets): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (fog logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (lattice control): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (bandwidth needs): fog hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and construction-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
